Characters added: Kotal Kahn, Sonya, Dvorah, Reptile, Quan Chi, Fera Torr, Ermac, Erron Black Background added: Snow Forest
Please visit http://community.wbgames.com/t5/MKX-Enhanced-Online-Beta-Forum/ct-p/MKX-BETA for more details.

Added Characters: Kung Jin, Shinnok, Cassie Cage, Kenshi, Kitana, Kung Lao, Kano, Raiden Added Background: Outworld Marketplace A fix was made to a situation where Shotgun Jacqui Briggs could continue a combo after her Single Barrel special move.
Please visit http://community.wbgames.com/t5/MKX-Enhanced-Online-Beta-Forum/ct-p/MKX-BETA for more details.

Added the following Characters: Liu Kang, Mileena, Jax and Takeda. Enabled interactables in the Training Room background. Fixed a frame zero desync that could happen when entering a match. Fixed a desync that could possibly occur when a fatality is performed. Fixed an issue that would cause the match to visually appear as if it were being played with 300 ms round trip latency when actual round trip latency was much lower. Fixed a graphical issue with Johnny Cage’s Stunt Double. Other minor fixes and optimizations.
Please visit http://community.wbgames.com/t5/MKX-Enhanced-Online-Beta-Forum/ct-p/MKX-BETA for more details.
